semantic_annotation_completion.classification_rule: every source-owned range is behavioral or port-contract; retained inert bytes have bounded no-consumer or unreachable-entry evidence

data_ranges.name: runtime_code_and_inline_tables
data_ranges.evidence: Decoded NMOS 6502 control flow from score handling through palette, entity, projectile, room, status, and input systems; inline tables have bounded indexed consumers.

data_ranges.name: runtime_data_tables_and_text
data_ranges.evidence: VDU streams, encoded text, palette values, counts, movement offsets, keyboard mappings, and retained unreferenced source bytes are separated and annotated at their exact boundaries.

data_ranges.name: room_layout_records
data_ranges.evidence: Sixteen fixed-size room records consumed by the packed room-tile and area-selection logic.

data_ranges.name: graphic_records
data_ranges.evidence: All sixty-four fixed-size Mode 2 records have source-owned semantic labels, consecutive graphic IDs, and bounded graphic_usage annotations. The player selector at $16E1 proves eight direction families with one upper cell and three lower animation frames; frame-phase groups 0, 1, and 2 select offsets +1, +2, and +3, while group 3 reuses +2. Other records are bounded by status, legend, enemy, collision, target, and animation consumers through the $2F40/$2F80 pointer tables.

data_ranges.name: object_and_status_graphic_ids
data_ranges.evidence: Object-indexed graphic IDs, target status IDs, and explicitly bounded unused padding before the pointer tables.

data_ranges.name: graphic_pointer_tables
data_ranges.evidence: Parallel high and low byte tables map each graphic ID to its 24-byte source record.

data_ranges.name: tile_generator_tables
data_ranges.evidence: Eight retained bytes followed by indexed tile generator offsets and pattern sources extending exactly to the runtime end.
